heading: INT. FLOODED TELEGRAPH OFFICE - RIVER TOWN - DAY

units.text: INT. FLOODED TELEGRAPH OFFICE - RIVER TOWN - DAY
Brown water stands six inches deep across the plank floor.
The counter has been propped on crates.
A potbelly stove sits cold.
Outside the single window, the main street is a slow brown river with a drowned wagon in the middle of it.
TOBIAS FINCH (60s, sleeve garters, spectacles on a string) perches on the counter with his boots tucked under him, working the telegraph key with two fingers.
He hums a hymn without a tune.
The door bangs open.
SHERIFF WILHELMINA "BILLIE" STRAND (40s, dripping slicker, silver star pinned crooked) wades in, dragging a man by the chain between his wrists.
The man, KITTREDGE (30s, split lip, hat gone), stumbles in her wake and falls to his knees in the water.
Up.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: It's cold.
units.name: KITTREDGE

units.text: So is the grave. Up.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: He climbs onto a crate by the wall.
She hooks the chain on a ring bolted to the plank.
She sits across from him on an overturned bucket, rifle across her lap.
Sheriff. I wasn't told you were coming.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: The bridge went out at noon. We didn't have a choice.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Is that Kittredge?
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: In the flesh.
units.name: KITTREDGE

units.text: Quiet.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Tobias looks from one to the other, then back at the key.
He taps out a few dots and dashes.
A fainter tapping answers from the line, and then a voice, thin and metallic, speaks from a brass horn on the wall.
Dry Fork office. Dry Fork. Do you copy, Finch?
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: I copy.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Judge Maddox says hold the prisoner. He rides in the morning.
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: Tell him there's no morning if this river keeps rising.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Sheriff says the river is up.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Judge says the river is the Lord's business. Hold the prisoner.
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: Billie stands.
She crosses the flooded floor and takes the horn from its hook.
She speaks into it low and flat.
This is Strand. I have a man in irons and a foot of water in the room. If the judge wants him in the morning, he can come get him.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: I'll relay that.
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: Relay it exactly.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: She hangs the horn on its hook.
Kittredge laughs, a wet, cracked sound.
She turns to him.
You'd have made a fine judge.
units.name: KITTREDGE

units.text: I'd have made a fine hangman, but they wouldn't give me the job.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Tobias stops tapping.
The river laps the stove legs.
A wagon wheel knocks against the building from outside, slow and steady, like someone asking to be let in.
How long before the water gets to the chain?
units.name: KITTREDGE

units.text: Long enough.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: And if it doesn't?
units.name: KITTREDGE

units.text: She steps close.
She crouches.
She looks him full in the face and he looks back, and neither blinks.
Between them, the water ripples with the rhythm of the wheel.
Then you and I and Tobias have one night to find out what each of us believes in.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Tobias takes off his spectacles and polishes them on his sleeve.
His hands shake slightly.
I believe in coffee, Sheriff.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: You've got a stove?
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Cold.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: You've got matches?
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: He opens a drawer under the counter, rummages, and holds up a damp box.
She takes it, shakes it, listens.
A faint rattle.
She nods once.
She wades to the stove, opens its door, pulls a handful of kindling from the crate beside it, and piles it inside.
She strikes a match.
It sputters.
Strikes another.
It catches.
For the first time in the room, there is warmth.
Kittredge leans toward it as far as the chain allows.
Tobias slides down off the counter into the water with a gasp, gathers his coat, and carries a pot to the stove.
The horn on the wall crackles once more.
Strand. Message from the judge.
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: Go on.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: He says: "Understood."
units.name: OPERATOR

units.text: Billie almost smiles.
She sits back down on the bucket and lays the rifle across her knees.
That's all?
units.name: KITTREDGE

units.text: That's plenty.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Outside, the drowned wagon shifts and begins, slowly, to turn downstream.
